title: Tech Note: Optimizing Record Selections - Part 2 — Under the Hood of the 4D Data File

historical_commentary.text: This note explains the core 4D concepts of current record, current selection, and named selections and how they affect performance with large data files and many concurrent users; these set-based selection concepts remain fully current in modern 4D (including ORDA-based entity selections), even though the specific v3/v6-era binary data file internals discussed as context have been long superseded by the modern structure file format.
related_updates: The binary .4DB/.4DC data file format discussed as background here has been long superseded by 4D's modern structure file format
Modern 4D adds ORDA entity selections alongside the classic current selection/named selection model described in this note, but the underlying set-based optimization principles carry forward
